windows.notes:
Security fixes. Updating is recommended.
- A backup job run by the system (as SYSTEM or root) always starts the copy of ucopy that was checked as safe, never one reached through a link that could be changed afterwards.
- Files copied off a phone onto the clipboard wait among your own files, not in Linux's shared temporary folder.
- A phone listing a folder inside itself, or sending an oversized thumbnail, can no longer crash the window.
- Linux: starting at sign-in works when ucopy is in a folder whose name has quotes or $, and disks under an encrypted volume or LVM show where they're mounted.

macos.notes:
Fixes for disk images.
- An image of a disk that was interrupted now carries on where it stopped, instead of reading the whole disk again (which wears a failing disk). It first checks a few sectors, so another disk at the same place, or an image damaged since, is imaged again.
- An image that can't be opened is never carried on in a new, empty file.
- Image a disk: the snapshot option now says that free space isn't read.
